categories.label: Conflict / war
categories.description: Armed conflict or naval action affecting a sea area or approach.

categories.label: Piracy / attack
categories.description: Attacks on merchant shipping in a defined risk area.

categories.label: Sanctions
categories.description: Trade restrictions changing which cargoes and flags may move.

categories.label: Labour action
categories.description: Industrial action affecting terminal or hinterland throughput.

categories.label: Port closure
categories.description: A port or terminal suspending operations.

categories.label: Protest / unrest
categories.description: Civil disruption around port access or hinterland corridors.

categories.label: Earthquake
categories.description: Seismic event with potential quay, crane or channel damage.

categories.label: Cyclone / storm
categories.description: Tropical cyclone or severe storm system over a sea area.

categories.label: Tsunami
categories.description: Tsunami warning or wave arrival affecting coastal facilities.

categories.label: Flood
categories.description: Flooding affecting terminal operations or hinterland access.

categories.label: Canal restriction
categories.description: Transit limits on a canal: draught, slot count or closure.

categories.label: Chokepoint disruption
categories.description: Passage through a strait or canal degraded, restricted or avoided.

categories.label: Energy shock
categories.description: Bunker or crude price movement changing routing economics.

categories.label: Commodity shock
categories.description: Commodity supply or demand shift changing trade volumes.

categories.label: Regulatory change
categories.description: Rule change affecting emissions, routing, crewing or cargo.

categories.label: Logistics disruption
categories.description: Rail, road, inland terminal or carrier network disruption.

categories.label: Infrastructure failure
categories.description: Crane, lock, channel or power failure at a facility.
